inalambriaDescription: Full time job. Web development, product design, software design.
inalambriaLongDescription: My first full-time job was at Inalambria, an instant messaging tech company. I was part of the innovation team, where I participated in the design and implementation of new software products for the company.
inalambriaResponsibilities: - Product design and development for new innovation initiatives. - End-to-end software design and implementation across frontend and backend. - Platform maintenance and operational support in AWS production workloads.
inalambriaAchievements: - Designed and implemented the first CI/CD pipeline in the company using CircleCI, and wrote around 200 automated tests to establish strong initial coverage for the flagship product. - Designed and implemented a horizontally scalable inbound messaging microservice for Facebook, SMS, RCS, and WhatsApp, using stateless processing and RabbitMQ to rate-limit and protect core services. - Led the flagship product MVP production deployment in AWS, configuring VPCs, security groups, load balancers, Elastic Beanstalk environments, and bastion hosts.

aboutMeText: I’m a Tech Lead / AI-minded Senior Software Engineer who loves turning complex problems into scalable, elegant systems. I’ve led backend teams, defined software architecture for microservices at scale, and built strong testing/CI frameworks. I enjoy mentoring engineers, aligning stakeholders, and building software.
chapterLeadDescription: Full time job leading a team of 26 engineers building a serverless microservice-based wealth-tech platform.
chapterLeadLongDescription: I lead 26 engineers shipping a serverless, microservice-based investment platform on TypeScript, AWS, and GitHub Actions.
chapterLeadResponsibilities: - Own backend architecture and internal tooling for better DX; keep the company’s 9 squads aligned with priorities. - Balance staffing across squads to protect delivery and deadlines. - Champion mentorship and career growth for backend engineers.
chapterLeadAchievements: - Rolled out company-wide AI architecture: centralized MCP gateway, internal/external tools and agents, secure discovery/auth, reusable skills—about 50% higher developer productivity. - Shipped a code review agent (human-in-the-loop, LLM-as-a-judge) trained on JIRA history, plus a TDD vibe-coding skill that writes code from specs and learns from senior PRs. - Broadened testing strategy: stage testing on anonymized production data, first frontend E2E suite, in-memory SQS/SNS replicas for local/CI; standardized clean architecture for new microservices.
backendDataLeadDescription: Expanded scope to Head of Data, leading the data engineering function and owning the company’s data platform and pipeline infrastructure.
backendDataLeadLongDescription: In this role, I design and lead the implementation of data architecture capabilities that unify business data, improve governance, and enable faster data-driven decisions across the organization.
backendDataLeadResponsibilities: - Defining data architecture standards for ingestion, storage, governance, and analytics consumption. - Leading cross-team initiatives to align backend systems and data platforms with business priorities. - Ensuring security and operational excellence across data pipelines and environments.
backendDataLeadAchievements: - Created data ingestion microservices to centralize heterogeneous sources into a single data lake while complying with technology and security standards. - Migrated all data software artifacts into a monorepo architecture with CI/CD pipelines, multiple deployment environments, and infrastructure-as-code standards. - Developed an AI agent that automatically writes SQL queries over the company data mart from natural language prompts, improving data accessibility for non-technical stakeholders.
tribeLeadDescription: Full time job supervising three backend development teams, overseeing their day-to-day activities, performance, and professional growth
tribeLeadLongDescription: In this role, I supervised three backend development teams, overseeing their day-to-day activities, performance, and professional growth.
tribeLeadResponsibilities: - Making critical architectural decisions, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and long-term business goals. - Strategically guiding backend engineers across 3 software squads to achieve project milestones. - Coordinating cross-functional initiatives to ensure coherence across the overall system.
tribeLeadAchievements: - Designed a fault-resilience framework for company messaging queues using autonomous retries, exponential backoff policies, and dead-letter queues to protect critical flows and reduce incident impact. - Refactored one of the company’s most critical microservices (KYC) to the new event-driven architecture I designed, decoupling services and introducing topic/queue-based communication with multiple external and internal transversal microservices. - Designed and implemented a company-wide event-driven architecture standard, leveraging AWS SQS/SNS for messaging, Terraform for infrastructure as code, and a monorepo approach to streamline development workflows and ensure architectural consistency across backend services.
squadLeadDescription: Full time job leading a backend team responsible for maintaining the Peruvian version of tyba
squadLeadLongDescription: In this role, I led a backend team responsible for maintaining the Peruvian version of tyba.
squadLeadResponsibilities: - Leading design and development of technical solutions aligned to business requirements. - Orchestrating cross-functional collaboration between business, operations, and development teams. - Ensuring reliability of Peruvian products through performance monitoring and incident resolution. - Upholding high code quality standards through reviews, best practices, and continuous improvement.
squadLeadAchievements: - Created a company-wide rate-limiting utility for external API integrations, leveraging Redis as a low-latency state manager plus internal logical queues and locks to control throughput safely. - Improved the SAGA pattern implementation by adding direct DB access in the orchestrator microservice, reducing orchestration latency and failure scenarios. - Established the Peruvian version of tyba as the most profitable product in the company.
midBackendDescription: Full time role as backend developer for a fintech platform used by thousands of users.
midBackendLongDescription: In this role, I designed and delivered core backend capabilities for mutual funds, portfolio operations, and customer communication features across the tyba platform.
midBackendResponsibilities: - Backend design and implementation of fintech product capabilities in microservice environments. - Continuous improvements in reliability, performance, and maintainability. - Cross-team collaboration with product and operations to deliver production-ready features.
midBackendAchievements: - Designed and implemented an accounting service to enable portfolio rebalancing for Colombia mutual funds, including tax calculations and tax translation between funds. - Designed and implemented a dynamic fund creation mechanism in the mutual funds platform, replacing the hardcoded JSON catalog with a database-driven model. - Designed a company-wide generic dashboard banner component to deliver key client communications; the implementation was robust enough to be used for 5+ years with zero core modifications.
